description: This file defines the CaseConvert class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for converting strings to lowercase, uppercase, and proper case, supporting both scalar values and arrays.

classes.name: CaseConvert
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert string case: lower, upper, proper.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to lowercase.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to uppercase.

methods.name: proper
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings to proper (title) case.
